name: frozen_source_transformer
normalization: Fixed source mean/std; no clipping, matching the existing frozen field reference. Missing features are zero after normalization. No learned missingness projection is added.
time: Real 10 Hz sampling; slice source positional embeddings and mask right-padding. No time stretching or invented observations.
selection_history: Chosen as the current operational default after inspecting Todd development results. Source weights and threshold are unchanged; this is not a prospectively selected independent zero-shot benchmark.
scope: Source-only AV/HV classifier transfer; upstream camera/trajectory processing uses target-domain adaptation and human review. Earlier Todd classifier fine-tuning is retained as a separate comparison.

sensitivity.public_cohort: Original fixed checkpoint's Vicolungo part2 test sources only; greedily keep disjoint original 40-point windows within each pair, ordered by time. Use the identical eligible cohort at every duration.
sensitivity.public_features: Recompute smoothing and derivatives after cropping raw measurements. Complete leader data. Primary deployment preprocessing is no clipping; archived clipped inference is checked only to verify restoration.
sensitivity.public_metric: Mean accuracy within each record-local pair, then within each source, then across sources. Also report window accuracy and class recalls.
sensitivity.field_cohort: Only current windows with at least 26 genuine samples; no extension or changed trajectory. One crop per video at each duration. Report the full 13-video default separately.
sensitivity.interpretation: Post-hoc duration diagnostic of fixed pretrained weights, not a comparison of training lengths or independent deployment generalization. No duration or placement is selected by accuracy.
